layout: per network, parts[i] lists the nodes along the i-th line part of its geojson (features in order, MultiLineString parts in order): [node, key, node, key, node, ...]. The first node is at the part's start; each later node sits at the key before it, 100 x its fractional vertex index along the part. Consecutive nodes are joined by an edge. km[e] is the length of edge e (edges numbered in that same order) in units of 0.1 km; fast lists the parts that are expressways. x, y are node coordinates x 100; city[i] is the node city i joins, -1 if none, cityKm[i] how far away it is; check is [parts, vertices] of the geojson the graph was built from.
